title: Stoneridge Announces Appointment of New Independent Director
summary: NOVI, Mich., Feb. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stoneridge, Inc. (NYSE: SRI) today announced that it will appoint Aron R. English as a member of its Board of Directors, effective March 16, 2026, pursuant to a cooperation agreement entered into with 22NW, LP.
